title: console-observability-triage-scratchpad-jordan
content:
Sprint-day scratchpad for console/observability triage - quick notes and to-dos.

Context:
- Morning: customer report from Acme Corp about missing latency bars on the model routing dashboard (route: eu-central-1 / model-x).
- Alerts: alert-rule "model-routing-latency-spike" firing intermittently (~3 AM UTC and 10 AM UTC).
- Recent deploy: frontend v2.14.1 + metrics ingestion change (prometheus -> pushgateway shim) deployed 2026-02-27.

Immediate checklist (actionable):
- [ ] Reproduce dashboard view locally + verify backend queries (Maya to assist)
  - local: yarn start-console + mock metrics from prod-snapshot (use last-24h)
  - query: Grafana panel uses promql: avg_over_time(latency_ms[5m]) grouped by route
- [ ] Check ingestion pipeline for missing tags (region/route) after shim (Samir)
  - hypothesis: shim drops "route" label for some exporters -> panels show aggregated (no bars)
- [ ] Triage JIRA-4521 (Acme: missing bars) - add logs and trace links, assign owner
- [ ] Rollback attempt? hold off until we confirm ingestion gap. If confirmed, hotfix pushing route label in shim.

Customer impact notes:
- Affects only dashboards that group by route/region (cost & latency breakdowns).
- Customers see "All routes" line only; per-route bars missing -> leads to confusion and escalations.
- Not impacting API requests or inference; internal metrics still show token-level metrics (confirm).

Debug notes / findings so far:
- Grafana panels return a single series with metric name but no "route" label for the time ranges reported by Acme (10:00-10:15 UTC).
- Pushgateway shim logs show intermittent 500s to metrics-collector w/ backpressure; some exporters retried without labels. (see logs snippet below)

logs (snippet):
- 2026-03-02T09:59:37Z ERROR shim.go:212 push failed: 502 Bad Gateway -> retrying (payload missing route label)
- 2026-03-02T09:59:42Z WARN shim.go:188 dropped labels: route=>"" for exporter agent id=ag-78

Quick experiments to run:
- Query raw metrics in prometheus: topk(10, sum by (route) (rate(request_latency_ms_count[5m])))  -> check cardinality
- Backfill check: look at archived metrics before 2026-02-27 and after to confirm label drop window
- Simulate shim with payload that includes/omits route label and observe ingestion behavior (local container)

Notes for comms (what to tell CS):
- Short message: "We're investigating missing per-route data on the console dashboards; it appears related to a metrics ingestion change and we're running tests to confirm. No impact to model inference. Will update in 2 hours or sooner."
- If customer requests ETA: give tentative 4-6 hours, dependent on regression verification and hotfix rollout.

Follow-ups / owners:
- Maya: reproduce dashboard + attach screenshots + Grafana query results (due EOD)
- Samir: pipeline logs & shim failure analysis (due in 2 hours)
- Jordan (me): open JIRA-4523 for the shim hotfix and coordinate canary rollout if needed. Prepare rollback plan for v2.14.1 frontend (if UI change is root cause).

Open questions / hypotheses:
- Is the shim idempotently rewriting labels? Might be a race when exporters retry.
- Could some exporters be on older agent versions that don't include route label? Need a quick inventory (agent versions by host).
- Is it limited to eu-central-1? Check other regions' dashboards for same time windows.

Related artifacts/links to paste into JIRA:
- Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/console-model-routing?panelId=3&from=1646098800000&to=1646100600000
- Shim logs (s3): s3://redwood-logs/ingest/shim/2026-03-02/shim-logs-20260302.gz
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/metrics-shim/pull/112 (recent change that touched labels)

Notes-to-self (scratchy):
- If hotfix: increment shim version, add stricter label validation + metrics test (CI) that simulates retries
- Add smoke test in staging: create fake exporter with missing label -> dashboards should still show placeholder series w/ "unknown-route"
- Add alert tweak: if series count < 2 for top routes -> fire a secondary alert w/ more context (makes triage faster)

End-of-day TL;DR (to paste in triage thread):
- Root cause hypothesis: metrics-shim change (2026-02-27) dropped route label for a subset of pushes during retry/backpressure -> dashboards that group by route collapsed into single series.
- Next steps: confirm via backfill + reproduce. If confirmed, hotfix shim and backfill/repair metrics or add UI placeholder.

-- Jordan
